stops.title: Ministry teams
stops.caption: Every team, and who leads it.
stops.speech: Departments are the ministry teams. Each one shows its lead, its deputy, and how many people serve on it.

stops.title: Inside a department
stops.caption: Roster, rota, recruitment, uniform.
stops.speech: Open one and you get its roster, its serving rota, the people applying to join, and the uniform for an upcoming service.
